attorneys: Amos Mathews and Robert J. Bernard for appellant., Solicitor General Griswold, Assistant Attorney General Turner, Howard E. Shapiro, Robert W. Ginnane and Raymond M. Zimmet for the United States et al., and John L. Arrington, Jr., for Missouri, Kansas & Oklahoma Coach Lines, appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motions to affirm are granted and the judgment is affirmed.
